entry.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
entry.summary:
Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. Its Experience Flywheel supplies diverse executable tasks to the NorthCUA Harness, which sustains long interactions, records decisions, and checks task outcomes.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents #reinforcement-learning
